rows.note: Retain 10 unchanged.

Retain 11 unchanged.

The frozen form is retained; equivalence of sector scope requires domain review.

rows.en: Key consideration 7: Integrating MHPSS into nutrition programming
rows.ne: मुख्य विचारणीय पक्ष 7: पोषणसम्बन्धी कार्यक्रममा MHPSS एकीकृत गर्ने।
rows.bt: Main consideration 7: Integrate MHPSS into nutrition-related programmes.

rows.en: Key consideration 8: Integrating MHPSS into camp coordination and camp management programming
rows.ne: मुख्य विचारणीय पक्ष 8: शिविर समन्वय तथा शिविर व्यवस्थापनसम्बन्धी कार्यक्रममा MHPSS एकीकृत गर्ने।
rows.bt: Main consideration 8: Integrate MHPSS into programmes related to camp coordination and camp management.

rows.en: Key consideration 9: Integrating MHPSS into shelter and settlement programming
rows.ne: मुख्य विचारणीय पक्ष 9: आश्रय तथा बसोबाससम्बन्धी कार्यक्रममा MHPSS एकीकृत गर्ने।
rows.bt: Main consideration 9: Integrate MHPSS into programmes related to shelter and settlement.

rows.en: Key consideration 10: Integrating MHPSS into water, sanitation and hygiene programming

rows.en: Key consideration 11: Integrating MHPSS into food security and livelihoods programming

rows.bt: Main consideration 11: Integrate MHPSS into programmes related to food security and livelihoods.

rows.en: Key consideration 12: The effectiveness of MHPSS activities will be limited if a person’s basic protection needs are not being met

rows.bt: Main consideration 12: If a person's basic protection-related needs are not being met, the effectiveness of MHPSS activities will be limited.
rows.note: General safety guidance drafted for review; the condition concerns unmet basic protection needs, not a clinical assessment.

rows.en: Key consideration 13: Meeting the needs and ensuring inclusion of persons with disabilities
rows.ne: मुख्य विचारणीय पक्ष 13: अपाङ्गता भएका व्यक्तिहरूका आवश्यकता पूरा गर्ने र उनीहरूको समावेशिता सुनिश्चित गर्ने।
rows.bt: Main consideration 13: Meet the needs of persons with disabilities and ensure their inclusion.

rows.en: Key consideration 14: What to do if referral options for mental health services are not accessible?
rows.ne: मुख्य विचारणीय पक्ष 14: मानसिक स्वास्थ्य सेवाका लागि सम्बन्धित सेवामा पठाउने कार्यका विकल्पहरू पहुँचयोग्य नभएमा के गर्ने?
rows.bt: Main consideration 14: What to do if options for referral to relevant services for mental health care are not accessible?
rows.note: The mental health service wording reuses the supplied unreviewed activity 3.10 candidate. This service-access question remains pending safety and language review.

rows.en: Key consideration 15: Assessments showing prevalence estimates of mental health conditions in humanitarian settings are not essential to initiate services
rows.ne: मुख्य विचारणीय पक्ष 15: मानवीय सहायताका परिवेशहरूमा मानसिक स्वास्थ्यसम्बन्धी अवस्थाहरूको व्याप्तिको अनुमान प्रस्तुत गर्ने लेखाजोखा सेवाहरू सुरु गर्न अत्यावश्यक हुँदैनन्
rows.bt: Key consideration 15: Assessments that present estimates of the prevalence of mental health conditions in humanitarian assistance settings are not essential for starting services
rows.note: The draft preserves that prevalence assessments are not essential for starting services, without prohibiting those assessments.

rows.bt: Main consideration 16: Adapt to the context.

rows.en: Key consideration 17: Considering the needs of: i) migrants caught in crisis, ii) refugees and asylum seekers, iii) internally displaced persons (IDPs), iv) stateless people
rows.ne: मुख्य विचारणीय पक्ष 17: निम्न व्यक्तिका आवश्यकताबारे विचार गर्ने: i) सङ्कटमा परेका आप्रवासी, ii) शरणार्थी र शरण खोज्ने व्यक्ति, iii) आन्तरिक रूपमा विस्थापित व्यक्ति (IDPs), iv) राज्यविहीन व्यक्ति।
rows.bt: Main consideration 17: Consider the needs of the following persons: i) migrants in crisis, ii) refugees and persons seeking asylum, iii) internally displaced persons (IDPs), iv) stateless persons.

rows.en: Key consideration 18: Implementing MHPSS activities remotely
rows.ne: मुख्य विचारणीय पक्ष 18: दूरबाट MHPSS गतिविधिहरू कार्यान्वयन गर्ने।
rows.bt: Main consideration 18: Implement MHPSS activities remotely.

rows.en: Key consideration 19: Design secure systems for information management
rows.ne: मुख्य विचारणीय पक्ष 19: सूचना व्यवस्थापनका लागि सुरक्षित प्रणालीहरूको डिजाइन गर्ने।
rows.bt: Main consideration 19: Design secure systems for information management.
rows.note: General information-security guidance drafted for review; no specific security controls have been added.

rows.en: Key consideration 20: Staff responsible for providing MHPSS to people affected by humanitarian emergencies should not also be responsible for workforce well-being
rows.ne: मुख्य विचारणीय पक्ष 20: मानवीय आपत्कालीन अवस्थाबाट प्रभावित व्यक्तिहरूलाई MHPSS प्रदान गर्ने जिम्मेवारी भएका कर्मचारी जनशक्तिको कल्याणका लागि पनि जिम्मेवार नहुनु उचित हुन्छ।
rows.bt: Main consideration 20: It is appropriate for staff responsible for providing MHPSS to people affected by a humanitarian emergency not to also be responsible for the well-being of the workforce.
rows.note: General staff-role separation guidance drafted for review. Workforce well-being is retained as a broad organizational responsibility, not recast as a clinical service. BT strengthens 'should not' to 'must not' and recasts the responsibility restriction as a prohibition on assigning responsibility. The revision expresses a recommendation that the same staff should not also be responsible for workforce well-being.

rows.en: Key consideration 21: Guidance on psychosocial support skills for specific groups or types of emergency
rows.ne: मुख्य विचारणीय पक्ष 21: विशिष्ट समूह वा आपत्कालीन अवस्थाका प्रकारका लागि मनोसामाजिक सहयोग सीपसम्बन्धी मार्गदर्शन।
rows.bt: Main consideration 21: Guidance on psychosocial support skills for specific groups or types of emergencies.
rows.note: The phrase for psychosocial support skills reuses wording from the supplied unreviewed activity 3.2 candidate; it is not newly coined clinical terminology.

rows.en: Key consideration 22: Training for protection actors with specific roles
rows.ne: मुख्य विचारणीय पक्ष 22: विशिष्ट भूमिका भएका संरक्षण क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत पक्षहरूका लागि प्रशिक्षण
rows.bt: Key consideration 22: Training for actors working in the protection sector with specific roles
rows.note: Key consideration uses a proposed recurring label absent from G-0.2; protection actor wording follows T168.

rows.en: Key consideration 23: Providing basic psychosocial support in health care settings
rows.ne: मुख्य विचारणीय पक्ष 23: स्वास्थ्य सेवा प्रदान गरिने स्थानमा आधारभूत मनोसामाजिक सहयोग प्रदान गर्ने
rows.bt: Key consideration 23: Providing basic psychosocial support at locations where health services are provided
rows.note: Key consideration requires a glossary entry. Basic psychosocial support wording reuses the supplied T099 activity label as an unreviewed candidate; no clinical validation is claimed.

rows.en: Key consideration 24: Integrating early childhood development activities into nutrition programmes
rows.ne: मुख्य विचारणीय पक्ष 24: पोषण कार्यक्रममा प्रारम्भिक बाल विकासका गतिविधि एकीकृत गर्ने
rows.bt: Key consideration 24: Integrating early childhood development activities into nutrition programmes
rows.note: The proposed Key consideration label is used for this heading on integrating activities into nutrition programmes.

rows.en: Key consideration 25: Supporting caregivers when a child has been sexually abused
rows.ne: मुख्य विचारणीय पक्ष 25: बालबालिकामाथि यौन दुर्व्यवहार भएको अवस्थामा हेरचाहकर्तालाई सहयोग गर्ने
rows.bt: Key consideration 25: Supporting caregivers in cases where children have been sexually abused
rows.note: General safeguarding heading, not a verbatim declaration; safety review pending. Key consideration uses the proposed recurring label.

rows.en: Key consideration 26: MHPSS focal points for learning spaces
rows.ne: मुख्य विचारणीय पक्ष 26: सिकाइ स्थलका लागि तोकिएका MHPSS सम्पर्क व्यक्तिहरू
rows.bt: Key consideration 26: MHPSS contact persons designated for learning sites
rows.note: Focal points denotes designated contact persons for learning spaces. Key consideration uses the proposed recurring label. Contact persons alone does not retain the designated responsibility conveyed by focal points; the revision makes designation explicit.

rows.en: Key consideration 27: Support the recruitment and retention of female teachers
rows.ne: मुख्य विचारणीय पक्ष 27: महिला शिक्षकहरूको भर्ती र उनीहरूलाई सेवामा कायम राख्ने कार्यमा सहयोग गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Key consideration 27: Support the recruitment of female teachers and their retention in service.
rows.note: Recruitment and retention are both retained. The heading uses the proposed Key consideration label. नियुक्ति denotes appointment, which is narrower than recruitment. The revision retains recruitment and retention as distinct activities.

rows.en: Key consideration 28: Gender-based violence (GBV)
rows.ne: मुख्य विचारणीय पक्ष 28: लैङ्गिक हिंसा (GBV)
rows.bt: Key consideration 28: Gender-based violence (GBV)
rows.note: GBV wording follows the supplied unreviewed T143 candidate; safety review pending. Key consideration requires a glossary entry.

rows.en: Key consideration 29: Male survivors of sexual violence
rows.ne: मुख्य विचारणीय पक्ष 29: यौन हिंसा भोगेका पुरुषहरू
rows.bt: Key consideration 29: Men who have experienced sexual violence
rows.note: Survivor wording follows the affected-person construction in supplied activity T108, applied to men. Proposed glossary entries are needed for Key consideration and survivors; safety review pending. Men affected by sexual violence can include indirectly affected men, whereas survivors identifies men who themselves experienced the violence. The revision makes direct experience explicit; survivor terminology remains pending safety-language review.

rows.en: Key consideration 30: Providing MHPSS to survivors of sexual violence and IPV through health services
rows.ne: मुख्य विचारणीय पक्ष 30: यौन हिंसा तथा IPV भोगेका व्यक्तिहरूलाई स्वास्थ्य सेवामार्फत MHPSS प्रदान गर्ने
rows.bt: Key consideration 30: Providing MHPSS through health services to people who have experienced sexual violence and IPV
rows.note: Both MHPSS and IPV are retained. Survivor wording follows the supplied T108 construction; Key consideration and survivors need glossary entries. Safety review pending. Persons affected by sexual violence and IPV is broader than survivors and may include indirectly affected people. The revision identifies people who experienced the violence, retaining both acronyms and delivery through health services; survivor terminology remains pending safety-language review.

rows.en: Key consideration 31: Evidence-based psychological interventions and delivery methods to manage prolonged psychological distress and common mental health conditions
rows.ne: मुख्य विचारणीय पक्ष 31: लामो समयसम्म रहने मानसिक व्यथा र सामान्यतया देखिने मानसिक स्वास्थ्यसम्बन्धी अवस्थाहरूको व्यवस्थापनका लागि प्रमाणमा आधारित मनोवैज्ञानिक हस्तक्षेप र तिनलाई प्रदान गर्ने विधिहरू
rows.bt: Key consideration 31: Evidence-based psychological interventions and methods of delivering them for the management of long-lasting mental distress and commonly seen mental health conditions
rows.note: The draft retains prolonged psychological distress and common mental health conditions as distinct targets of management without adding named diagnoses or therapies.

rows.en: Key consideration 32: Do not offer psychological debriefing
rows.ne: मुख्य विचारणीय पक्ष 32: [psychological debriefing] प्रदान गर्ने प्रस्ताव नगर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Main consideration 32: Do not offer to provide [psychological debriefing].
rows.note: The named intervention remains in exact source English, and the instruction retains the explicit prohibition on offering it. The draft prohibits providing the intervention, whereas the source prohibits offering it. The repair explicitly prohibits offering to provide it and retains the exact source-English intervention name.

rows.en: Key consideration 33: Ensure clarity of roles
rows.ne: मुख्य विचारणीय पक्ष 33: भूमिकाहरू स्पष्ट भएको सुनिश्चित गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Key consideration 33: Ensure that roles are clear.
rows.note: This is an ordinary instruction about role clarity, not a clinical item. Key consideration uses the proposed recurring label.

rows.en: Key consideration 34: Child and adolescent survivors of sexual violence
rows.ne: मुख्य विचारणीय पक्ष 34: यौन हिंसा भोगेका बालबालिका र किशोरकिशोरीहरू
rows.bt: Key consideration 34: Children and adolescents who have experienced sexual violence
rows.note: Both children and adolescents are retained. Survivor wording follows the supplied T108 construction; Key consideration and survivors need glossary entries. Safety review pending. Affected children and adolescents can include those indirectly affected, whereas survivors identifies those who experienced sexual violence themselves. The revision retains both age groups and makes direct experience explicit; survivor terminology remains pending safety-language review.

rows.en: Key consideration 35: MHPSS as part of the public health emergency response
rows.ne: मुख्य विचारणीय पक्ष 35: जनस्वास्थ्य आपत्कालको प्रतिकार्यको अङ्गका रूपमा MHPSS
rows.bt: Key consideration 35: MHPSS as part of the response to a public health emergency
rows.note: The public health emergency and response terms follow T170 and T174. Key consideration uses the proposed recurring label.

rows.en: Key consideration 36 Providing services in places where people are deprived of their liberty
rows.ne: मुख्य विचारणीय पक्ष 36 मानिसहरूलाई स्वतन्त्रताबाट वञ्चित गरिने स्थानहरूमा सेवा प्रदान गर्ने
rows.bt: Key consideration 36 Providing services in places where people are deprived of liberty
rows.note: The deprivation-of-liberty wording follows supplied activity T113. The source has no colon after 36; Key consideration uses the proposed recurring label. The existing wording describes places where people deprived of liberty are located, rather than explicitly places where people are deprived of their liberty. The revision restores that relationship and preserves the absence of a colon after 36.

rows.en: INTRODUCTION
rows.ne: परिचय
rows.bt: Introduction
